name: Jira
description: Jira Cloud for a host that keeps its own grant: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) on granular scopes, a REST v3 client through the site's cloud id, and the issue tracker interface of the account sources library

extensions.description: A person's Jira Cloud grant, projects, assigned issues, and one issue opened or closed at a time, for a host that keeps its own grant
